name: Shadeling
description: The smallest and most common Hollow expression. A smear of wrongness that drifts along the ground.

attacks.name: Corrosive Touch
attacks.special: Organic materials (wood, leather) take double damage

passives.name: Amorphous
passives.description: Can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch. Cannot be grappled or restrained.

passives.name: Corruption Trail
passives.description: Organic surfaces crossed take 1 necrotic damage. Leaves visible marks.

passives.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
passives.description: In direct sunlight: disadvantage on attacks and -2 AC.

hollow.veil_effect: Ambient sounds thin in 10 ft radius. Birdsong stops.

behavior.tactics: No tactics. Drifts toward nearest life energy. Clusters naturally but does not coordinate.

narration.first_sighting: A smear of darkness drifts across the ground — shapeless, wrong, leaving a trail of withered grass in its wake.
narration.attack_cue: It reaches for you — not with a hand, but with its entire form pressing against yours. Where it touches, your skin burns cold.
narration.wounded_cue: The shadeling shudders, its form flickering, edges dissolving into nothing.
narration.death_cue: It disperses — a burst of black mist that thins and vanishes. Where it was, the ground is grey and dead.
narration.ambient_cue: A patch of shadow that moves against the light. The grass beneath it is already dying.

name: Hollowmoth
description: Airborne drift expressions. Patches of visual and auditory distortion that flutter in erratic patterns.

attacks.name: Distortion Flutter
attacks.special: No real damage. On hit: target has disadvantage on next Perception check

passives.name: Swarm Signal
passives.description: Where hollowmoths gather, stronger Hollow follows within 1d4 hours. DM receives a staging cue to prepare the next encounter.

passives.name: High-Frequency Whine
passives.description: All creatures within 30 ft: -1 to Concentration checks. Stacks with multiple moths (max -3).

passives.name: Drawn to Life
passives.description: Hollowmoths cluster around the creature with the highest current HP in range.

actives.name: Blinding Swarm
actives.description: All creatures in 10 ft: DEX save DC 10 or Blinded for 1 round. The swarm coalesces into a disorienting cloud.
actives.narration_cue: The swarm coalesces into a disorienting cloud.

hollow.veil_effect: Barely perceptible high-frequency whine. Faint melodic patterns almost resolve into language but never quite do.

behavior.tactics: No aggression. Swarms around living creatures. Real danger is as a warning signal and debuff.

narration.first_sighting: Something flickers at the edge of your vision — patches of air that don't look quite right, fluttering in a rhythm that's a fraction too slow.
narration.attack_cue: The moth passes through your space and for a moment the world smears — colors shift, edges blur, then snap back.
narration.wounded_cue: N/A — moths are killed outright or not at all
narration.death_cue: It blinks out, like a candle flame pinched. One less wrongness in the air.
narration.ambient_cue: A soft papery flutter and a whine just below the threshold of hearing. Your jaw clenches without you knowing why.

audio.ambient: papery flutter loop + HLW high-frequency whine

name: Grey Wolf
description: A grey hunting wolf that tracks prey in coordinated packs.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: DC 11 STR save or knocked prone

passives.name: Pack Tactics
passives.description: Advantage if an ally is within 5 ft of the target.

passives.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
passives.description: Advantage on related Perception checks.

behavior.tactics: Packs surround prey. Target prone creatures. Retreat if alpha falls.

narration.first_sighting: A low howl rolls through the brush, answered from both sides of the trail. Grey shapes close the gap.
narration.attack_cue: A growl breaks into a sharp snap as the wolf lunges for your leg.
narration.wounded_cue: A yelp cuts short, then the wolf backs away with its ears flat.
narration.death_cue: A last whine fades into the grass as the pack goes quiet.
narration.ambient_cue: Soft panting passes through the undergrowth, first near, then farther off.

audio.ambient: soft panting and paws in leaf litter

name: Wild Boar
description: A territorial wild boar that charges intruders and guards its range.

attacks.name: Tusk
attacks.special: If charged 15+ ft before attack: +1d6 damage

passives.name: Relentless
passives.description: 1/day, if reduced to 0 HP by an attack dealing 7 or less damage, drop to 1 HP instead.

passives.name: Charge
passives.description: Bonus damage after moving 15 ft before a tusk attack.

behavior.tactics: Territorial. Charges at intruders. Does not pursue beyond territory.
behavior.morale: Fights to death defending territory. Flees if encountered outside territory.

narration.first_sighting: A rough snort comes from the thicket, followed by the scrape of hooves on hard earth.
narration.attack_cue: A squeal rises as the boar drives its tusks toward you.
narration.wounded_cue: A grunt shakes its broad chest, but it plants its feet again.
narration.death_cue: A final breath rattles through its teeth before the brush falls still.
narration.ambient_cue: Snuffling and the smell of churned soil drift from the field edge.

name: Giant Spider
description: A ceiling-climbing spider that traps prey in webbed ruins and caves.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: DC 12 CON save or Poisoned 1 hour + 1d6 poison damage

attacks.name: Web
attacks.special: Target Restrained (STR DC 12 or slash through, AC 10, 5 HP)

passives.name: Spider Climb
passives.description: Climb 30 ft on surfaces including ceilings.

passives.name: Web Sense
passives.description: Knows location of any creature touching its web.

passives.name: Darkvision
passives.description: Darkvision 60 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush predator. Webs exits, waits on ceiling, drops on webbed prey. Climbs 30 ft. Retreats to web if threatened in open.

narration.first_sighting: A dry click comes from above, then another answers from inside the web.
narration.attack_cue: A hiss of silk cuts across the passage as the spider casts its web.
narration.wounded_cue: A chittering rasp follows the blow, and its legs draw close.
narration.death_cue: A brittle crunch ends in silence as the web slackens.
narration.ambient_cue: Soft clicks travel overhead while silk brushes the stone.

audio.ambient: dry clicks and taut silk creaking
audio.attack: hiss of a lunge or cast web

name: Bandit
description: An armed road robber who ambushes travelers and bargains when outmatched.

actives.name: Dirty Fighting
actives.description: 1/encounter: throw dirt or sand. Target is Blinded for 1 round unless it passes a DEX save DC 12.
actives.narration_cue: Dirt scatters with a dry hiss before the target cries out.

behavior.tactics: Ambush from cover. Focus downed targets. Demand surrender before attacking if outnumbered.
behavior.morale: Flees at half HP or if leader falls. Surrenders if clearly outmatched.
behavior.group_size: Gang of 3-6, often with 1 Bandit Captain (Tier 2)

narration.first_sighting: Leather creaks beyond the bend, and a crossbow string draws tight.
narration.attack_cue: A bowstring twangs as the bandit fires from cover.
narration.wounded_cue: A grunt escapes through clenched teeth as the bandit staggers.
narration.death_cue: A sword clatters on stone, followed by one last breath.
narration.ambient_cue: Low whistles trade between the trees on either side of the road.

name: Thornveld Stalker
description: A tree-climbing forest predator that pounces on isolated travelers.

attacks.name: Pounce
attacks.special: Requires 20 ft movement. Target DEX save DC 13 or knocked prone. If prone: free bite attack (1d6+3)

passives.name: Keen Smell
passives.description: Advantage on Perception checks by smell.

passives.name: Forest Camouflage
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth in forest terrain.

behavior.tactics: Ambush predator. Climbs 20 ft, stalks from trees, and pounces on isolated targets. Will not attack groups of 4+.

narration.first_sighting: A branch creaks above you, then comes the smell of wet fur.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp growl drops from the canopy as claws rake forward.
narration.wounded_cue: A yelp turns to a rasp, and the stalker scrambles for height.
narration.death_cue: A final breath catches in its throat before the branches settle.
narration.ambient_cue: Leaves rustle overhead, though the air at ground level is still.

name: Corrupted Treant
description: A Hollow-touched grove guardian whose roots choke the ground around it.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.special: Target pushed 10 ft

attacks.name: Thorn Barrage
attacks.special: DEX save DC 14. 15 ft cone. Half on success

passives.name: Vulnerability to Fire
passives.description: Takes double fire damage.

passives.name: Resistance
passives.description: Resists bludgeoning and piercing damage.

passives.name: Rooted Aura
passives.description: Plants within 30 ft grow aggressively; the area is difficult terrain.

actives.name: Entangling Roots
actives.description: All creatures within 15 ft: STR save DC 14 or Restrained. The ground erupts with roots.
actives.narration_cue: Roots crack through the earth and coil around nearby legs.

behavior.tactics: Territorial guardian of corrupted groves. Twisted by proximity to Hollow corruption; still natural, but warped and hostile. Prioritizes fire-users as threats.
behavior.morale: Fights to death defending its grove. Will not pursue beyond 100 ft of its tree.
behavior.group_size: Solitary (guarding 2-3 normal trees that are its grove)

narration.first_sighting: Wood groans deep in the grove, and sour rot cuts through the pine scent.
narration.attack_cue: Roots crack underfoot as the treant swings a heavy limb.
narration.wounded_cue: A splintering snap rings out while dark sap seeps from its trunk.
narration.death_cue: A long creak subsides into silence as the great trunk falls.
narration.ambient_cue: A slow grinding sound moves from tree to tree beneath the smell of spoiled sap.

audio.attack: groaning limb swing and root crack

name: Steppe Razorwing
description: A sharp-winged hunter that dives from the open highlands.

attacks.name: Talons
attacks.special: On hit from a dive (30+ ft descent): +1d6 damage

attacks.name: Wing Slash
attacks.special: Can target two adjacent creatures

passives.name: Flyby
passives.description: Doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when flying away.

passives.name: Keen Sight
passives.description: Advantage on Perception checks by sight.

behavior.tactics: Dive-attacks from height. Targets small or isolated creatures. Retreats to altitude between attacks.
behavior.morale: Flees after taking any damage (unless defending nest).

narration.first_sighting: A shrill whistle cuts through the high wind above you.
narration.attack_cue: A wing snaps in the wind as talons rake downward.
narration.wounded_cue: A harsh screech breaks off as its flight falters.
narration.death_cue: A last whistle thins into the wind as feathers settle.
narration.ambient_cue: Wingbeats rustle overhead in the open air.

name: Steppe Bison
description: A powerful herd beast of the Drathian grasslands.

attacks.name: Gore
attacks.special: If charged 20+ ft: target STR save DC 14 or knocked prone and Stunned 1 round

passives.name: Stampede
passives.description: If 3+ bison charge in the same direction, all creatures in the path: DEX save DC 14 or 2d8 bludgeoning damage and knocked prone.

behavior.tactics: Herd animal. Normally docile. Panics and stampedes when threatened. Individual bison charge only when cornered or defending calves.
behavior.morale: Stampedes away from danger. Individual fights to death only if cornered.

narration.first_sighting: Heavy hoof thuds roll across the grass.
narration.attack_cue: A furious snort precedes the charge.
narration.wounded_cue: A pained grunt rises above the pounding herd.
narration.death_cue: A final breath rattles as the massive body falls.
narration.ambient_cue: Low grunts and hoof thuds travel across the plain.

name: Rock Viper
description: A small venomous snake concealed among mountain stones.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On hit: +1d6 poison damage. DC 11 CON save or Poisoned 1 hour. Failed by 5+: Paralyzed 10 min

passives.name: Camouflage
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth checks in rocky terrain.

passives.name: Tiny
passives.description: Can hide in cracks and crevices. Climbs 20 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush. Hides in rocks, strikes exposed ankles or hands. Does not pursue.

narration.first_sighting: A dry hiss leaks from between the stones.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp hiss accompanies a strike at your ankle.
narration.wounded_cue: A thin rasp escapes as it recoils into a crack.
narration.death_cue: Its last hiss fades beneath the scrape of loose grit.
narration.ambient_cue: Pebbles scrape and a faint hiss answers from the rocks.

name: Cave Wyrm
description: A hungry scaled predator that tunnels through mountain caves.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On crit: target grappled (escape DC 14)

attacks.name: Tail Sweep
attacks.special: DEX save DC 14 or knocked prone. Reach 10 ft

attacks.name: Acid Spit
attacks.special: Recharge 5-6. DEX save DC 13 for half. Corrodes metal armor (-1 AC until repaired)

multiattack: 2 attacks — one Bite and one Tail

passives.name: Tremorsense
passives.description: Detects movement through ground within 30 ft.

passives.name: Darkvision
passives.description: Darkvision 60 ft.

passives.name: Scales
passives.description: Resists acid damage. Climbs 30 ft and burrows 10 ft.

behavior.tactics: Ambush from tunnel walls or ceiling. Uses tremorsense to detect approaching prey. Fights aggressively — cave wyrms are always hungry.
behavior.morale: Fights to 25% HP, then attempts to burrow and escape.

narration.first_sighting: A deep rasp rolls through the tunnel walls.
narration.attack_cue: Stone cracks under its claws as jaws lunge forward.
narration.wounded_cue: A guttural growl echoes off the cave roof.
narration.death_cue: A final rattling breath fades into the deep passage.
narration.ambient_cue: Claws scrape the rock beyond the bend.

name: War Golem
description: An ancient stone and steel guardian bound to its last command.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.special: Target pushed 10 ft

attacks.name: Stone Throw
attacks.special: Throws chunks of itself. Each throw reduces max HP by 5 until repaired

passives.name: Damage Immunity
passives.description: Immune to poison and psychic damage.

passives.name: Resistance
passives.description: Resists non-magical physical damage.

passives.name: Magic Resistance
passives.description: Advantage on saves versus spells.

passives.name: Immutable Form
passives.description: Immune to effects that would alter its form.

behavior.tactics: Follows last instructions given by its creator. Most Keldaran war golems guard ancient holds or mines. They do not communicate and cannot be reasoned with. They perform their duty until destroyed.
behavior.morale: Fights to destruction. Cannot flee, surrender, or negotiate.

narration.first_sighting: Stone grinds against steel somewhere ahead.
narration.attack_cue: A heavy clatter marks the swing of its arm.
narration.wounded_cue: Metal groans as a plate splits from its frame.
narration.death_cue: A long grinding crash ends in silence.
narration.ambient_cue: A steady stone scrape paces the ancient hall.

name: Saltmarsh Lurker
description: A submerged marsh predator that drags prey beneath the water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: On hit: target grappled (escape DC 12). Grappled targets pulled underwater next turn

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.special: Reach 10 ft

passives.name: Hold Breath
passives.description: Can hold its breath for 30 minutes. Swims 40 ft.

passives.name: Ambush from Water
passives.description: Advantage on Stealth while submerged.

passives.name: Swamp Camouflage
passives.description: Camouflages in swamp terrain.

behavior.tactics: Lies submerged near banks or fords. Grabs creatures at the water's edge and drags them under.
behavior.morale: Releases prey if it takes 10+ damage in one hit.

narration.first_sighting: A wet squelch stirs at the bank.
narration.attack_cue: Water slaps the shore as jaws snap shut.
narration.wounded_cue: A low hiss bubbles through the reeds.
narration.death_cue: A last gurgling breath rises through the water.
narration.ambient_cue: Reeds rustle and water drips into the mud.

name: Tidecaller Eel
description: A territorial coastal eel that discharges lightning through water.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.special: Target grappled (escape DC 14)

attacks.name: Lightning Discharge
attacks.special: CON save DC 13. Water only; all creatures in water within 15 ft. Recharge 5-6

passives.name: Water Breathing
passives.description: Breathes underwater. Swims 50 ft.

passives.name: Electricity Absorption
passives.description: Immune to lightning; heals HP equal to lightning damage dealt to it.

passives.name: Keen Vibration Sense
passives.description: Detects movement in water within 60 ft.

behavior.tactics: Territorial in coastal waters. Uses Lightning Discharge to stun prey, then bites grappled targets.
behavior.morale: Retreats to deep water if outmatched on shore.

narration.first_sighting: A faint electrical crackle runs across the water.
narration.attack_cue: A sharp snap breaks from the water before the discharge.
narration.wounded_cue: A wet rasp follows its thrashing tail.
narration.death_cue: The crackle fades into a final splash.
narration.ambient_cue: Water sloshes against rock beneath a low electrical hum.
